role: Read-only 01/05/09 oil curve with four listed contracts, half-month cutoffs, complete histories, and reserved standard-futures specifications.

reference.monthly.note: Visible spot OHLC aggregated from two half-month turns; H1 contains only weeks 1-2.

mainContinuous.monthly.note: Visible backward-ratio-adjusted main OHLC, rolling on the first half of 01/05/09 expiry months.

curve.contracts[].monthly.note: Named OIL-YYMM history from listing through cutoff or expiry, at most 16 monthly and 64 weekly bars.

invariants: exactly four 01/05/09 delivery-month contracts are listed
one standard lot represents 1000 barrels and one minimum tick is 10 USD per lot
one month contains two game turns and no week beyond the half-month cutoff is published
each named contract has at most 16 months and 32 half-month turns
the expiry-month contract settles to the visible spot reference at H2
the main series rolls to the next delivery month at H1 of an expiry month
the main series is backward-ratio-adjusted and non-tradable
margin rates are reserved parameters and are not enforced while orders are disabled
curve factors are persistent long slope, near pressure, and curvature states
no future weekly close or later annual macro state is used at a cutoff
no player, order, position, or portfolio state is a pricing input
no write-back to global macro or commodity overlay
